info.title: Herculean API
info.description: The API of Herculean, a workout log for people who train on a fixed weekly split.

post.description: Creates an account and signs it in. Name, units and default rest time are set afterwards, in setup.

201.description: The account was created and is signed in.

400.description: A field is not valid. The errors name each field.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

email.description: Unique regardless of case. At most 254 characters.

timeZone.description: The phone's IANA time zone, for example Europe/Zagreb.

type.description: A link to the HTTP status in RFC 9110.

title.description: The HTTP status name, for example Conflict.

detail.description: A sentence that explains the error.

code.description: A stable code for the app, for example user.email_taken. Field errors have validation.

errors.description: Only when the code is validation: messages per field, with field names as in the request.

traceId.description: Finds the request in the logs.

ProblemDetails.description: An error, as Problem Details (RFC 9457). Every error has the same fields.

accessToken.description: A JWT. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: Gets new tokens when the access token expires. Keep it in secure storage.

TokenResponse.description: The OAuth 2.0 token response (RFC 6749), in camelCase.
